title: Several workspaces of different scope, posterior and frontal

statements.text: IWMT can be read as a Bayesian version of global workspace theory that posits multiple workspaces of varying scope, including unconscious local ones. A posterior workspace supports iterative state estimation for overt and covert action, and a broader frontal workspace conditions those estimates on deeper causal models.

sources.quote: IWMT can be understood as a Bayesian version of G(N)WT.
IWMT is distinct from GNWT in that it is committed to the idea of multiple kinds of workspaces with varying scopes and functions
